cases.name: Native Sales customer creation captures primary ownership in its creation transaction and cannot claim a pre-existing organization
Legacy access-grant replacement cannot silently remove current primary Sales authority or change ownership
Sales customer, pending account, ownership and invitation are atomic and replay-safe without exposing credentials
Duplicate identity/phone/business and role escalation cannot claim another Sales customer
Existing invitation activation makes the customer usable and preserves assigned primary Sales
Server-validated referral survives registration and binds the correct Sales only after email activation
Locked Sales and expired referral never silently assign registrations
Admin handover is versioned, audited and exact-once; old managed access is revoked
Company name normalization blocks whitespace/case duplicates without changing the existing owner
Provider uncertainty keeps a single pending account and reports UNKNOWN without rolling back customer or exposing secrets
Concurrent distinct requests for one identity create one customer only
Native PostgreSQL quote notification and concurrent handover commit without deadlock while preserving the original Sales snapshot
Pending referral cannot activate under a locked Sales; audited Admin handover resolves it without changing token or assigning silently
